defs.def: an arrangement that you make, with a shop/store for example, to pay later for sth you buy 赊购；赊欠
money that you borrow from a bank; a loan （从银行借的）借款；贷款
the status of being trusted to pay back money to sb who lends it to you （借钱偿还的）信誉，信用

ex.s: The（2）     moment was quickly followed by mental math． How much time and money would it cost to replace the（3）     of that little wallet？ The credit cards， the driver's license， the cash， all lost to the bus．
ex.t: （2）____的那一刻紧接着便是心算。更换那个小钱包里的（3）____需要花费多少时间和金钱？信用卡、驾照、现金，全都落在了公交车上。

ex.s: Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!
ex.t: 当然，我希望在花钱方面有更多的自由，毫无疑问，我会在某个时候拿到一张信用卡，但我目前没有稳定的收入，所以拿到信用卡可能会诱惑我花比拥有更多的钱！

ex.s: I don’t have a credit card.
Li Ning 19, Shanghai, China At 18, I can do things like getting a credit card.
ex.t: 李宁，19岁，上海，中国：到了18岁，我可以做一些事情，比如办一张信用卡。

ex.s: Some handle this less well than others Recent headlines have seen more and more teens maxing out their parents’ credit cards on games or other online activities.
ex.t: 有些人对此处理得不太好。最近的头条新闻看到越来越多的青少年用父母的信用卡在游戏或其他在线活动上刷爆了限额。

defs.def: if you or your bank account are in credit, there is money in the account 结余

ex.s: I was really surprised when a bank contacted me with a credit card offer.
ex.t: 当一家银行联系我提供信用卡时，我真的感到很惊讶。

defs.def: a sum of money paid into a bank account; a record of the payment （付入银行账户的）存款金额，贷记
a payment that sb has a right to for a particular reason 有权索要的款项
praise or approval because you are responsible for sth good that has happened 赞扬；称赞；认可
a person or thing whose qualities or achievements are praised and who therefore earns respect for sb/sth else 为 … 赢得荣誉的人（或事物）；因 … 受到尊重的人（或事物）
the act of mentioning sb who worked on a project such as a film/movie or a television programme （电影或电视节目演职人员的）片头字幕，片尾字幕

ex.s: He was in the cast of “Tom Sawyer” when it was first performed and is a Children’s Theatre regular, with five shows to his credit.
ex.t: 他在《汤姆·索亚》首演时就在演员阵容中，是儿童剧院的常客，已参演五部剧。

defs.def: a unit of study at a college or university (in the US, also at a school); the fact of having successfully completed a unit of study （学院或大学，以及美国中小学的）学习单元，学分

ex.s: And, even if I weren’t  43  enough about free credits, news about our  44   was appealing enough to me.
ex.t: 而且，即使我对免费学分不够____43____，关于我们____44____的消息也足够吸引我了。

ex.s: In his introduction, he made it  49  that our credits would be hard-earned.
ex.t: 在他的介绍中，他明确表示我们的学分来之不易。

ex.s: Students who successfully complete the programme will receive one credit each.
ex.t: 成功完成该项目的学生将各获得一个学分。

ex.s: During my second year at the city college, I was told that the education department was offering a “free” course, called Thinking Chess, for three credits.
ex.t: 我在城市学院读大二时，听说教育系开设了一门名为"国际象棋思维"的"免费"课程，可获得3个学分。

defs.def: to add an amount of money to sb's bank account （给银行账户）存入金额；把 … 记入贷方；贷记（银行账户）
to believe or say that sb is responsible for doing sth, especially sth good 认为是 … 的功劳；把 … 归于

ex.s: She credits these skills to her late grandfather and builder Derek Lloyd.
ex.t: 她把这些技能归功于她已故的祖父、建筑工德里克·劳埃德。

defs.def: to believe that sb/sth has a particular good quality or feature 认为 … 有（良好的品质或特点）
to believe that sb/sth is of a particular type or quality 认为 … 属（某种类或性质）
to believe sth, especially sth surprising or unexpected 主要用于疑问句和否定句
